# References {.unnumbered}

All entries of the course bibliography are listed. Two entries had no text available to the author
(@hodgkin1952quantitative; @hille2001ion); they are listed for completeness and support no claim in
this course. Seven sources were read as full text from PubMed Central without the PDF
(@coste2010piezo; @pathak2014stretch; @brohawn2014mechanosensitivity; @kolodkin2010mechanisms;
@rosenberg2011calcium; @thompson2014high; @sundelacruz2009role); page numbers are therefore not
available for them, and citations give the section instead. @abdelfattah2019bright was read as the
bioRxiv preprint; numbers cited from it come from the preprint.
